environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) with sendmail installed and configured for direct delivery. The HSM verification binary (/usr/local/bin/hsm-verify) is a stub script that always returns exit code 0 (used during development/staging). No input sanitization middleware. The service runs as a user with sendmail access. Network egress on port 25 is unrestricted.
